svg.title: Customer Assistant — D365 Live Agent Handoff Sequence
svg.desc: Seven participants: Customer, Chatbot, Agent, Skill, MCP, KB, D365 Omnichannel. Multi-turn clarification is followed by approved knowledge retrieval and handoff eligibility assessment. The human-handoff skill summarizes and redacts authorized conversation context. MCP submits the summary to D365 and obtains a live-support link tied to the handoff reference. Customer-initiated continuation shows queue status, summary availability for the assigned human agent, and the actual connected event. Link issuance, queue entry and agent connection are separate states. Create or resume handoff is a logical integration operation, not a claim of a native API name. Twenty-three numbered messages. Transparent canvas and editable text.

g.text: Repeat as needed, within configured clarification limits.
Prepare Handoff & Obtain Live Support Link
Present the Link & Connect to Live Support
